g.text: Consequences measured by health economic evaluations, by income setting

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Base: 27,897 single-country eligible studies with a known publication-year World Bank income group (20,236 high income; 7,661 low and middle income). A study can report

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: several outcome families. Panel A omits the residual other-clinical family and families below 5% in both settings. Panel B excludes incomplete 2026. Consequences are

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: extracted from titles and abstracts; reporting does not establish quality.
